```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 420"
     role="img" aria-labelledby="title desc">
  <title id="title">Pelican riding a bicycle</title>
  <desc id="desc">A white pelican with a long orange bill pedals a teal bicycle under a golden sun.</desc>

  <defs>
    <g id="wheel" stroke="#243b49">
      <circle r="65" fill="#fffaf0" stroke-width="8"/>
      <circle r="55" fill="none" stroke="#96b7ba" stroke-width="2"/>
      <path d="M-55 0H55 M0-55V55 M-39-39L39 39 M-39 39L39-39"
            stroke="#96b7ba" stroke-width="2"/>
      <circle r="6" fill="#243b49"/>
    </g>
  </defs>

  <!-- A sunny path -->
  <rect width="600" height="420" rx="24" fill="#e5f6f4"/>
  <circle cx="496" cy="83" r="37" fill="#ffcf69"/>
  <path d="M0 352Q150 336 300 352T600 352V420H0Z" fill="#c9e9dc"/>
  <path d="M70 370H534" stroke="#a2cec0" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <g fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round">
    <path d="M58 94H127 M78 81H115 M414 135H460"/>
    <path d="M58 230H104 M37 250H81 M64 273H90" opacity=".8"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Wheels and frame -->
  <use href="#wheel" x="161" y="302"/>
  <use href="#wheel" x="435" y="302"/>
  <g fill="none" stroke="#168e8c" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"
     stroke-linejoin="round">
    <path d="M161 302L228 215L275 302Z M228 215H389L275 302 M389 215L435 302"/>
    <path d="M228 215L218 193 M389 215L379 193"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="none" stroke="#243b49" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round">
    <path d="M196 193H239"/>
    <path d="M379 193L369 168H393Q407 168 407 180"/>
  </g>
  <circle cx="275" cy="302" r="17" fill="#fffaf0" stroke="#243b49" stroke-width="4"/>
  <path d="M275 302L300 279H318" fill="none" stroke="#243b49"
        stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Pelican, including the long bill and its pouch -->
  <g stroke="#243b49" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <path d="M335 77Q388 79 455 104Q414 134 364 121Q345 115 335 99Z"
          fill="#ffb45f"/>
    <path d="M335 77Q388 78 455 104Q403 103 350 96Z" fill="#ffd385"/>
    <path d="M289 108Q275 86 294 68Q313 50 339 65Q357 75 355 94
             Q354 110 333 116Q315 122 320 144Q326 169 300 185
             Q261 210 208 189Q183 178 165 147Q194 155 218 144
             Q248 129 273 139Q301 149 289 108Z" fill="#fffaf0"/>
    <path d="M219 157Q250 143 281 161Q305 176 323 175
             Q343 173 367 165Q378 165 374 174Q348 196 320 194
             Q280 193 254 182Q230 175 219 157Z" fill="#e1eeed"/>
  </g>
  <circle cx="331" cy="82" r="5.5" fill="#243b49"/>
  <circle cx="332.5" cy="80.5" r="1.6" fill="#fff"/>

  <!-- Bent leg and webbed foot on the pedal -->
  <path d="M252 185L287 222L287 262" fill="none" stroke="#243b49"
        stroke-width="12" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <path d="M252 185L287 222L287 262" fill="none" stroke="#ffb45f"
        stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <path d="M283 259Q300 262 316 273Q320 278 311 279L286 276
           Q278 273 283 259Z" fill="#ffb45f" stroke="#243b49" stroke-width="4"/>
</svg>
```
